policy.tokens: Arabic letter runs; punctuation and ordinary hemistich separators are boundaries
policy.normalization: remove Arabic marks/tatweel; fold alef variants, maqsura, hamza seats and ta marbuta as search
policy.conjunctions: full attached surface forms; detached waw is a separate token; no stemming
policy.splits: join only explicit tatweel-before-# in derived analysis
policy.shortlist: retain legacy normalized keys; merge collisions; no stop-word or length filters
policy.labels: unique legacy label unchanged; collision label by unmarked edition frequency then Unicode order
policy.order: descending occurrences then Unicode normalized key; source poem IDs in Unicode order
